figurative_meaning_en: To speak in straightforward and simple language
example_sentences_in_bangla: কী বলতে চাইছো বুঝতে পারছি না, একটু বাংলা করে বলো।
এই জটিল ব্যাপারটা বাংলা করে বললে সবাই বুঝবে।
example_sentences_in_english: I can't understand what you're trying to say, please put it in plain English.
If you explain this complicated matter in simple terms, everyone will get it.
note: This idiom reflects the cultural emphasis on clear communication in Bengali-speaking regions, often used when someone uses overly complex or foreign-influenced language.
